newsitem.title: CHILE: South American port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: South American port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

CHILE, Feb 10 - Arica - Three vessels berthed and working normally, 1 berth vacant. 6 Vessels due during the week. Iquique - Two vessels berthed and working normally, 2 berths vacant. 10 Vessels due during the week. Antofagasta - Four vessels berthed, 1 berth vacant. 6 Vessels due during the week to load/discharge concentrates, bulk copper, containers, general cargo. Valparaiso - Eight vessels berthed and working normally, no berths vacant, no delays. 1 Berth (pier 3) out of service until April for enlargement. 15 Vessels due during the week, 1 day delay expected. San Antonio - Seven vessels in port operating, 1 berth vacant. 22 Vessels due during the week. Port busy but no waiting time. Puerto Montt - Two coasters berthed, 2 vessels due during the week. Punta Arenas - One vessel, 1 coaster berthed, 3 vessels due during the week.

Conception Bay ports - 21 Vessels due this week to the different terminals. Talcahuano - One vessel berthed and working normally, 2 due this week, none in roads. San Vicente - Three vessels berthed and working normally, no berths vacant. 9 Vessels due during the week, 1 day berthing delay expected. Navy pier (Molo 500) - No vessels berthed. Steel pier - 1 Vessel berthed, 1 due this week. Coronel pier - 1 Vessel berthed, 1 due. Oil terminal - 1 Vessel at terminal, 2 due this week. Lirquen - Three vessels due, 3 berths vacant, 5 vessels due during the week. Penco - No vessels at terminal.

PERU, Feb 10 - No strikes at any port. Callao - Seven vessels anchored, 4 general cargo/container vessels berthed, no berthing delays. Paita - No vessels anchored, 1 frozen fish vessel berthed, no berthing delays. Bayovar, Pisco - No vessels, no delays. Talara - One vessel anchored, 1 oil tanker berthed, no berthing delays. Chimbote - One fish meal vessel anchored, no vessels berthed, no berthing delays. Ilo - No vessels anchored, 3 fish oil vessels berthed, no berthing delays.
VENEZUELA, Feb 10 - Puerto Cabello - No vessels anchored, 5 berthed of which 1 containers, 1 under repair, 3 bulkers. Piers 1 and 2 closed. Guanta - Four vessels anchored, 6 general cargo berthed.
